header.desc: Filters 공급자별 호환성 확인. 상수 데이터만 조회하며 테이블을 생성하거나 변경하지 않음

commands.statement:
SELECT M.userid, M.content, M.score FROM ( SELECT 'user001' AS userid, N'HandStack 100%_! [x] 한글' AS content, 90 AS score, 0 AS isdeleted, CAST('2026-10-14' AS date) AS businessdate, CAST('2026-10-14T12:34:56.123456' AS datetime2(6)) AS createdat, CAST('2026-10-14T12:34:56.123456+00:00' AS datetimeoffset(6)) AS occurredat, CAST(1 AS bit) AS enabled, CAST('00112233-4455-6677-8899-aabbccddeeff' AS uniqueidentifier) AS itemguid UNION ALL SELECT 'user002' AS userid, N'Filter sample' AS content, 70 AS score, 0 AS isdeleted, CAST('2026-10-13' AS date) AS businessdate, CAST('2026-10-13T12:34:56.123456' AS datetime2(6)) AS createdat, CAST('2026-10-13T12:34:56.123456+00:00' AS datetimeoffset(6)) AS occurredat, CAST(0 AS bit) AS enabled, CAST('11112233-4455-6677-8899-aabbccddeeff' AS uniqueidentifier) AS itemguid UNION ALL SELECT 'user003' AS userid, N'Filter sample' AS content, 100 AS score, 1 AS isdeleted, CAST('2026-10-14' AS date) AS businessdate, CAST('2026-10-14T12:34:56.123456' AS datetime2(6)) AS createdat, CAST('2026-10-14T12:34:56.123456+00:00' AS datetimeoffset(6)) AS occurredat, CAST(0 AS bit) AS enabled, CAST('11112233-4455-6677-8899-aabbccddeeff' AS uniqueidentifier) AS itemguid ) M WHERE M.isdeleted = 0
ORDER BY M.userid;
